title: Decentralize drive
tagline: Every File Link doesn't Expire. Store your important documents safely and securely with decentralized file storage.
description: This is a safe and secure personal file storage system. Generally whenever we store our docs to google drive the link to the doc might expire or we might lose the doc if we forget Gmail or lose or Gmail account since it is centralized. D-drive is decentralized we can store our docs and share the link which will never expire. we can access it by login into metamask  wallet. We have used the private network of IPFS to store the file and then stored the link on the node. this way this is private as well. We can also make it public and share the link if needed.
how_its_made: This is a very simple and useful project. W didn't run into any challenge. Things went smooth apart from internet hinderance
